caseName: New York Continental Jewell Filtration Co. v. Wynkoop
caseNameFull: The New York Continental Jewell Filtration Company, in Error v. Mary E. Wynkoop
summary: In error to the Court of Appeals, of the District of Columbia.
attorneys: Mr. James H. Hayden for plaintiff in error. Mr. Charles A. Douglas and Mr. E. B. Sherrill for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Writ of error dismissed for the want of jurisdiction. Code D. C., § 233; Walker v. United States, 4 Wall. 163; Thompson v. Butler, 95 17. S. 694; District of Columbia v. Gannon, 130 U. S. 229; Baltimore & Potomac Railroad Company v. Hopkins, 130 U. S. 210; United States ex rel. Lisle v. Lynch, 137 U. S. 280; United States ex rel. Taylor v. Taft, Secretary, 203 U. S. 461.
